feeds.title: Mostly Amélie
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Amélie. This is a yoga blog, a wellness travel and veganism diary, an attempt at a conscious lifestyle, and some tips on life as an expat in Berlin.

feeds.title: Warm Hearts Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sarah Brannen. I'm a yoga teacher and family yoga teacher based in St Andrews, Fife. I help people of all ages to practice yoga together so they can feel healthier and happier.

feeds.title: MACROVegan Blog
feeds.description: The MACROVegan Vision defines a clear and practical guide for the future of food ethical, environmental and social impact of what we eat. We can do this.

feeds.title: Don't Waste Your Taste blog
feeds.description: My Name is Rahel Lutz and I am a vegan Food Blogger from Basel in Switzerland. 'Don't Waste Your Taste' is my creative output where I get to share all the yummy recipes with you. My wish is to inspire as many people as possible with healthy plant based recipes which I create in my little kitchen that I share with my two flat mates.

feeds.title: Julia K Healthy Living
feeds.description: I'm Julia, I teach yoga classes online and around Bedford, along with one to one yoga sessions, retreats, workshops and on demand classes. I write about yoga and food which relates to and enhance your yoga.
